requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium 2.5D sports game environment backdrop, 1536x1024 landscape.
Primary request: wide, shallow side-on view of a playful nighttime backyard coliseum. Cinematic rich hand-painted animated-film environment with beautiful art direction and tactile brushwork.
Scene: monumental warm brass crown architecture made from giant collectible card sleeves; deep ink and navy night; mint and amber floodlights slicing through atmospheric haze; handmade fan banners and a lively crowd confined to the distant stands. One suspended blank scoreboard high at center.
Composition: a wide stage for sideways gameplay, low shallow perspective. The ENTIRE lower half is an empty uninterrupted sports floor across the full width, unobstructed and usable for gameplay. All architecture, fans, banners and scoreboard concentrated above the floor, background-only. Readable clean floor. Rich cinematic depth above, quieter floor below.
Palette: deep ink/navy, aged warm brass, mint, amber.
Constraints: no players, no foreground characters, no sports equipment, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Scoreboard completely blank.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent separated-piece 2D animation rig sprite sheet, exactly 1536x1024 landscape, 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows (12 cells).
Subject: demo man "Mack", a lovingly exaggerated sturdy bearded adult man, swept brown hair, cream baseball jersey with burgundy sleeves, teal trousers, white sneakers, confident goofy character. Premium hand-painted cel illustration, dark confident outlines, warm brass highlights and rich subtle painterly shading. Consistent shallow right-facing 3/4 view for every part.
Composition is strictly a regular 4-column x 3-row equal cell grid. Each separate component is centered entirely inside its own equal cell with generous transparent margins. No components overlap or cross cells. No visible grid lines.
Exact parts, read left to right:
ROW 1: head with neutral confident expression / same head delighted / same head annoyed / torso only from neck to pelvis including cream jersey, no arms and no legs.
ROW 2: left upper arm including burgundy sleeve / left forearm with hand / right upper arm including burgundy sleeve / right forearm with hand.
ROW 3: left thigh in teal trousers / left shin plus white sneaker / right thigh in teal trousers / right shin plus white sneaker.
These are separate rig parts, not a complete standing character. All limb segments complete and fully painted at the joint ends so they can overlap for animation. Consistent character identity and scale, no cropped parts.
Constraints: true transparent alpha background. Do not paint checkerboard or any opaque background. No ground shadows, no text, labels, numbers, UI, symbols, grids, or extra parts. Exactly the twelve specified nonoverlapping cutout components.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent separated-piece 2D animation rig sprite sheet, exactly 1536x1024 landscape, 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows (12 cells).
Subject: "Captain Marmalade", an adorable chunky orange tabby cat with expressive green eyes, cream muzzle and belly and a little burgundy bandana. TRUE QUADRUPED FELINE anatomy and proportions, not humanoid. Premium hand-painted cel illustration, dark confident outlines, warm brass highlights, subtle rich painterly shading. Consistent shallow right-facing profile for every piece.
Composition is strictly a regular 4-column x 3-row equal cell grid. Each component centered entirely inside its own equal cell with generous transparent margins, separate and NONOVERLAPPING. No grid lines.
Exact parts, read left to right:
ROW 1: cat head neutral / same head delighted / same head annoyed / cat torso only, horizontal quadruped body with cream belly, neck and burgundy bandana, no head, legs or tail.
ROW 2: near front upper leg / near front lower leg and paw / far front upper leg / far front lower leg and paw.
ROW 3: near hind bent leg with paw / far hind bent leg with paw / curved striped tail / same cat head with focused expression.
These are separate rig pieces, not assembled full cats. All joint ends fully painted for clean overlap in animation. Keep character identity, scale, fur markings and style consistent across components.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background, no fake checkerboard or opaque background. No ground shadows, no text, labels, numbers, UI, symbols, grid lines, or extra parts. Exactly the twelve specified nonoverlapping cutout components.
